key_points.text: This is part of our ongoing series on the creator economy.
key_points.evidence_quote: This is part of our ongoing series on the creator economy.

key_points.text: The big picture is that innovations like non-fungible tokens or NFTs are creating new ways for collectors and investors to buy, sell.
key_points.evidence_quote: The big picture is that innovations like non-fungible tokens or NFTs are creating new ways for collectors and investors to buy, sell, and trade digital art.

key_points.text: And marketplaces powered by NFTs open up new revenue streams for creators, because anytime digital art is resold.
key_points.evidence_quote: And marketplaces powered by NFTs open up new revenue streams for creators, because anytime digital art is resold, no matter how many times down the line, the creator gets a percentage of those secondary sales.
